# Outside Observations

> A visual research archive: a curated collection of ~2,500 photographic and
> video works, browsable by artist, year, subject, tags and mood. Works are
> presented for educational and research purposes; rights remain with their
> creators.

## What this site offers

- /archive: the full collection, searchable (?search=<query>) and filterable
  by mood. Each entry has its own page with title, artist, year, description
  and structured data (schema.org VisualArtwork).
- /archive/unexpected-connections: an AI-assisted comparison of two works.
- /archive/widline-cadet: featured artist collaboration.

## Usage policy

- Citing and linking to entry pages is welcome.
- Image files are not licensed for reuse or model training. Rights holders can
  request removal at contact@outsideobservations.com.
